reproduces: A company's contact page: an ordinary three-field contact form, under the equal-opportunity line the company carries in its site-wide footer. The residual left when the boilerplate was demoted from weight 2 to weight 1 — it landed exactly on the threshold — and the case that closed it at weight 0.
vendor: none (a company's own site, deliberately off the ATS host list)
reconstructed: Everything. The footer sentence is the ordinary equal-opportunity line, in the generic wording a company uses rather than any particular company's; it is deliberately NOT self-identification wording, because that block is decisive and this one is not. The three contact fields are the same ones a checkout and an application form both ask for, which is the whole difficulty: nothing in this page's SHAPE distinguishes it, only the weight of what is written on it.

page.text: Get in touch and we will reply within two working days. Acme is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate.
